description: Get the full record for an award notice: supplier, value, contract dates, procurement method, selection criteria, limited tendering reason, trade agreements, commodity codes, description and contact. Look it up by reference number, solicitation number or contract number. A solicitation that led to several awards, as supply arrangements do, returns the 20 most recent and the total count.

id.description: Reference, solicitation or contract number, exactly as shown in search results.

max_description_chars.description: Cut the description to this many characters. Raise it when description_truncated is true and you need the rest.
